coder_notes: Glioblastoma named in conditions; no GBM-specific expansion arm (expansion arms are NSCLC, SCCHN, RCC, CRC, ovarian), so GBM patients would enter only the dose-escalation/dose-finding parts. NGM707 is the only investigational agent in monotherapy arms (experimental_monotherapy there) and is combined with pembrolizumab in Part 1b and Arms A-C; coded experimental_combination with pembrolizumab as a co-investigational partner (pembrolizumab is not SOC and not given in all arms). Regimen coded combination because combination arms exist; monotherapy arms also exist. Mechanism of NGM707 is not stated; drug_class_hint inferred from the exclusion of prior ILT2/ILT4/HLA-G-targeted therapy. Plasma-only PK.
